newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India's ONGC Nov crude output falls 8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: India's ONGC Nov crude output falls 8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: India's state Oil and Natural Gas Corp Ltd's total crude oil production for November has fallen by 8 percent year-on-year, a company official said on Tuesday.
The official said the total crude output from main oil producer ONGC in November was 2.35 million tonnes compared to 2.546 million tonnes a year ago.

Production for this fiscal year, April 1996 to March 1997, has so far been lagging from last fiscal year with total production up to November reaching 19.169 million tonnes compared to 21.181 million tonnes in the same period last year.

The main cause has been the continuing fall in output at the country's largest hydrocarbon producing area, the Bombay High Basin, which fell to 1.643 million tonnes in November, a drop of 50,000 tonnes over October and nearly 200,000 tonnes from the same period last year.

ONGC's natural gas production from the Basin, its main gas producing area was still on the rise with 1.1269 trillion cubic metres produced in November, compared to 1.1714 trillion cubic metres in October and a year-on-year rise from 1.0961 trillion cubic metres.
The Basin's monthly output of liquidfied petroleum gas (LPG) similarly rose to 93,020 tonnes this October, up from 91,263 tonnes year-on-year.
